{{Quote|Noooo! You can't&hellip;|Grev T'Ran before his death|<ref name="Target" />}}
'''Grev T'Ran''' was an individual who served as a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], T'Ran was one of ten individuals who appeared before [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in his [[Emperor's throne room|throne room]], where the Emperor announced the news of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star's]] [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destruction]] at the hands of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. [[Force sense/Legends|Sensing]] T'Ran's delight at the news [[Force power/Legends|through]] [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Palpatine confirmed his suspicions about the commander and ordered one of his [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Royal guards]] to [[Death/Legends|execute]] him. T'Ran was killed when the guard stabbed him in the neck with a [[Force pike/Legends|force pike]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|The Death Star has been destroyed.|Emperor Palpatine|<ref name="Target" />}}
[[File:Emperor_Sidious.png|thumb|right|180px|T'Ran was executed by the orders of Emperor Palpatine (pictured).]]
Grev T'Ran was a member of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Over the [[Standard year/Legends|years]], he rose to the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Commander/Legends|commander]] and became regarded as one of the most powerful Imperials in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Target" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="NERC" /> T'Ran was among ten individuals summoned by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to his [[Emperor's throne room|throne room]]. Evaluating their loyalty through their reactions, the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] delivered the news that the Rebel Alliance had [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destroyed]] the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]<ref name="Target" /> [[Space station/Legends|space station]].<ref name="Episode IV">{{Film|IV}}</ref> [[Force power/Legends|Using]] [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Palpatine [[Force sense/Legends|detected]] T'Ran's true feelings; despite his somber expression, the commander inwardly displayed the beginnings of a smile. This confirmed Palpatine's suspicions that T'Ran was a Rebel sympathizer. The Emperor then signaled one of his [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Royal Guards]] to [[Death/Legends|execute]] T'Ran, who drew his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and tried to resist before being stabbed in the neck with a [[Force pike/Legends|force pike]].<ref name="Target" />

==Personality and traits==
Having earned a powerful position in the Empire, T'Ran's name alone inspired fear in all who opposed him. His [[Heart/Legends|heart]] was devoid of mercy and his career was marked by acts of great cruelty.<ref name="Target" />

==Skills and abilities==
Grev T'Ran was regarded as a capable [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] whose skills earned him a promotion to the rank of commander in the Galactic Empire. Palpatine considered him part of a group of people who could destroy [[Starship/Legends|ships]] or [[City/Legends|cities]] with just a single word.<ref name="Target" />

==Equipment==
T'Ran had a blaster that he kept at his side.<ref name="Target" />

==Behind the scenes==
Grev T'Ran appeared in [[Alex Wheeler]]'s [[2008]] novel ''[[Rebel Force: Target]]'', the first volume in the ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Force]]'' series.<ref name="Target" />
